caption: The video captures several translucent, sharp-edged shards suspended in a near-black void, lit from one side so their thin edges glow pale blue-green. A large shard hangs at the top-right corner, remaining essentially fixed as a reference against which the other motion is read. Below it, a smaller elongated shard drifts steadily downward from the upper-middle toward the lower center, its outline tilting and rotating as it tumbles through the descent. Along the bottom edge, a loose cluster of additional shards creeps slowly downward, with the leftmost fragment gradually slipping out of view while the others remain near the lower border. Fine dust specks scatter across the darkness, shifting slightly relative to the essentially fixed top-right piece, suggesting a slow drift of the particulate field. No impact or release is visible. The falling is already underway at the start and continues past the end. The central shard is still descending and turning at the end, its motion unbroken and continuous.
